task.title: Page persisted recurrence occurrences safely
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/883 by paging sparse persisted provenance for one exact recurrence through bounded authored-offset windows.
acceptance_criteria: Load one authoritative recurrence and inspect only persisted coordinates selected by a bounded authored window of at most 1024 offsets.
Return ordered sparse results and advance the caller-owned cursor by authored offsets even when the page contains gaps.
Fail closed for selected corruption while isolating malformed records outside the requested recurrence and window, without granting lifecycle or execution authority.

attempts.diagnostic: Recurrence-store tests failed because persisted_occurrences_page did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added sparse, gap, final, missing definition, bounds, reopen, selected corruption, and out-of-window corruption-isolation tests.

attempts.diagnostic: Scanning occurrence streams or deriving a cursor from returned rows would blur the corruption domain and stall sparse pagination.
attempts.patch: Projected the bounded authored window once, replayed only selected exact coordinate streams, validated returned records against the authoritative recurrence, and documented cursor and authority contracts in ADR-0048.

attempts.diagnostic: CodeRabbit identified duplicated OutOfRange conversion in exact persistence and persisted paging flows.
attempts.patch: Added one From conversion, removed both duplicate mappings, reran just verify, waited through incremental review throttling, and obtained a no-actionable-comments exact-head review before merge.

outcome.summary: The recurrence store pages sparse immutable provenance through bounded authored-offset windows with deterministic cursor progress, authoritative validation, and narrow corruption isolation.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- record validate corpus/development/0174-bounded-persisted-occurrence-paging.json # result: valid development record
nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- corpus inspect corpus/development # result: inspected 174 records: 174 valid, 0 invalid

lessons: Sparse paging cursors should advance by the authored coordinate window rather than the number of returned persisted rows.
Project the authoritative recurrence once per page and reuse canonical exact-coordinate replay instead of reloading the definition per coordinate.
Only malformed selected coordinates belong to the page's corruption domain; unrelated recurrence and out-of-window corruption remain isolated.
CodeRabbit found duplicated OutOfRange conversion in the exact and paged flows; one shared From conversion was added and both duplicate mappings were removed.
Centralized error conversion keeps exact and paged APIs aligned as their shared taxonomy evolves.
Read-only provenance paging does not grant persisted cursors, due policy, claims, materialization, dispatch, retries, or execution authority.
